Principal.title: Principal
Principal.description: A registered principal: typed id, class, lifecycle status, display label — no credential material, no tenancy membership, no provider fields.

IdentityRecordVersion.title: IdentityRecordVersion
IdentityRecordVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized identity document (currently 1).

PrincipalId.title: PrincipalId
PrincipalId.description: Opaque principal identity: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug; the single source of principal identity.

PrincipalKind.title: PrincipalKind
PrincipalKind.description: Principal class: human, agent, solver, robot, or service — never a vendor, product, or model.

PrincipalLifecycleState.title: PrincipalLifecycleState
PrincipalLifecycleState.description: Principal lifecycle: active (eligible to authenticate), suspended (temporarily barred, reversible), or disabled (barred, retained for audit).
